initialization.A: Kaiming uniform with a=sqrt(5), standard nn.Linear initialization
initialization.fresh_history: restore same A/B and empty Adam; one persistent adapter set through all tasks

frozen: All original model weights including router, attention, norms and head. No new router, adapters follow each original expert activation.

optimizer.name: AdamW
optimizer.gating: Actual factor displacement including decay; one multiplier for all six factors of an expert. m0 leaves learned adapter active and advances Adam only when gradients are present; gradNone skips standard AdamW state/decay. m1 leaves exact candidate unchanged. Effective BA change is bilinear, not strictly scaled by m.

smoke.scope: Integration and descriptive end-to-end costs, not a statistically stable throughput benchmark or full continual-learning result.

main_comparators: fixed allocation including standard uniform update and development-selected strong static reference
learned shared controller; PPO candidate, not executed today
clone: diagnostic only; not a fourth main method class
action_interface: Shared expert encoder with layer/group base and sparse distinct-expert corrections; 1024 positions, no independent agents or full-dimensional independent random exploration.
general_ability: Independent final evaluation only; adapter enabled on same deployment model at initial and later checkpoints. Per-ability initial/absolute/delta retained. No general evaluation data in reward or selection; future optimization requires separate budgeted online proxy.
future_comparison: Only if real remaining time sufficient, lock a separate bounded fixed/rule short comparison before execution; no PPO training today.
